Fate owners can sell to a cash buyer, list with an agent, or sell without fixing anything. Demand comes from a city that grew from about 500 people in 2000 to an estimated 23,000 in 2022. Because growth was so fast, many nearby homes are recent builds, and an older or heavily worn house competes against newer neighbors.

That is the main reason owners here choose an as-is sale. It skips staging, repairs and the wait while a financed buyer's appraisal clears.

  • Cash offer: short closing, no repair list, usually at a discount.
  • Agent listing: more exposure and a higher possible price, with showings.
  • Inherited or vacant house: sort out title and utilities first.

The city went from 497 residents in 2000 to 6,357 in 2010, 17,500 in 2019 and 23,000 in 2022. The comprehensive plan expects it to pass 50,000 people at build-out. New subdivisions keep arriving, so buyers have choices and price and condition count for more than location alone.

Rockwall ISD serves the west side of the city and Royse City ISD the east side. Confirm which one covers your address, because buyers ask early.

Water comes from the North Texas Municipal Water District. Electric service is split between a member-owned co-op, Farmers Electric Cooperative, and the Oncor grid, where residents pick a retail provider. Atmos Energy supplies natural gas. The city bills for trash and recycling, and Waste Connections does the pickup under contract. Pet registration costs $5.00 per pet.

  • Save recent water, electric and trash bills to show a buyer.
  • Write down which electric provider the house uses.
  • Explain how the trash carts change hands when you move out.

The Building Safety department enforces the adopted codes: the 2021 International Building, Residential, Plumbing, Fire, Mechanical and Energy Conservation codes, the 2021 Fuel Gas Code and the 2023 National Electric Code. Contractors must register with the city, and the city posts a list of those who have.

If you added a deck, converted a garage or did other work, ask Building Safety whether permits were pulled. A missing permit can slow a buyer who needs a loan, and a cash buyer will lower the price to cover the risk. Fixing the paperwork before listing is cheaper than negotiating it afterward.

Buyers in North Texas ask about weather damage. If your house had burst pipes after the February 2021 freeze, a roof replacement or an insurance claim, keep every document, since an inspector or lender may ask for it.

  • Roof age and receipts for storm repairs.
  • Plumbing work done after hard freezes.
  • Insurance claim records and payouts.

Fate is a short drive from Dallas, and the closest DART station is Downtown Rowlett, about 17 miles west. STAR Transit buses serve parts of Rockwall and Kaufman counties, with a GoPass app for monthly and day passes. Commute options are worth a line in a listing.

Know your numbers before you read offers. The items below usually come out of what you receive.

  • Costs that reduce your proceeds: the loan payoff, unpaid taxes, recording fees and title charges.
  • Costs a buyer may ask you to cover: repairs found at inspection.
  • Costs you can avoid: agent showings and staging, if you take an as-is offer.

The city has spent on downtown land, parks and a $15 million road bond issued in July 2021, and a Brookshire's grocery opened in March 2022. Mention nearby parks, stores and roads in a listing only if you can point to them on a map.

A sale to a cash buyer moves in a short chain. You request offers, compare the net on each, pick one and sign a contract. The buyer opens title with a closing office, which searches the records for liens, unpaid taxes and name problems. Anything found has to be cleared before funding. You then sign the deed in front of a notary, the office pays off your lender and the tax share, and the rest is yours.

Most delays come from paperwork, not the buyer. Bring your deed, your newest tax bill, a loan payoff letter, utility accounts you plan to close and keys or garage remotes for every door. If the house is vacant, tell the buyer who has been looking after it. If a relative owns part of the house, that person must sign too.

  • Ask how long the buyer needs after the contract is signed.
  • Ask who pays for the title policy and recording.
  • Ask whether the offer changes after the buyer walks the house.

Probate court in the county can admit a will within four years of the owner's death, and what happens next to the title depends on the estate. Heirs may skip full administration with a muniment of title, as long as the only debts are secured by the real estate.

The small estate affidavit is for estates worth $75,000 or less, not counting the homestead. It generally cannot move real property other than a homestead going to a spouse or minor children, and a judge has to sign off. Because Fate lies in Rockwall County, a deed or probate order is recorded with that county's clerk.

  • Transfer on death deed: filed while the owner is alive.
  • Executor's deed: used when an estate is administered.
  • Affidavit of heirship: sworn, but a buyer need not accept it.

Have a probate attorney choose the route before you say yes to a buyer.

Each taxing unit picks its own rate, and the appraisal district sets value as of January 1. Statements go in the mail about October 1, payable on receipt, and January 31 is normally the final day before the account is delinquent.

A balance still open on February 1 gets a six percent penalty and one percent interest. The year's lien attaches January 1. The Rockwall County tax office handles vehicle registration for Fate, and the county tax assessor-collector commonly bills property tax as well, so ask the county office for the figure on your parcel.

After closing, the deed goes on the public record at the clerk's office.

faqs.a: The population rose from 497 in 2000 to 23,000 in 2022. The comprehensive plan expects it to pass 50,000 at build-out.
Rockwall ISD serves the west side and Royse City ISD the east side. Confirm your address with the district before you list.

faqs.q: Does Fate require permits for home repairs?
faqs.a: Building Safety enforces adopted codes including the 2021 International Residential Code, so ask the city before structural, electrical or plumbing work.

faqs.q: Can I sell an inherited Fate house without probate?
faqs.a: Sometimes. A transfer on death deed recorded before the owner died or a muniment of title can avoid full administration, but an affidavit of heirship alone may not satisfy a title company.

faqs.q: When are Texas property taxes due on a Fate home?
faqs.a: Bills go out around October 1 and the tax is delinquent after January 31. A six percent penalty and one percent interest apply starting February 1.
